group.passage: If you see a dog in a harness walking calmly through a train station, it may be a guide dog at work. In Taiwan, about 60,000 people are visually impaired, but only around 50 guide dogs are working. Each of these dogs has spent years getting ready for the job. A guide dog's life begins with a volunteer family. When a puppy is about 2 months old, it moves in with a foster family. For about a year, the family helps it get used to living among people and learn good habits at home, while the training school pays for its food and medical care. Some puppies even practice staying calm in a stadium full of cheering baseball fans. When the dog is about one and a half years old, it returns to the school for about another year of training. There it learns to stop at steps, walk around things in its way and lead its user safely. Raising a guide dog takes about three years in all, yet only about 30 percent of the dogs pass. Taiwan's first guide dog, a Labrador named Aggie, began working in 1996. At first, some buses refused to carry her, and some restaurants turned her away. Her user worked hard to change the rules. Today, the law says guide dogs, and puppies with their trainers, may enter public places, restaurants and public transport. Owners may not refuse them or charge extra, and a place that keeps refusing can be fined up to NT$50,000. Still, 47 cases of guide dogs being refused were reported between 2023 and 2025. The law also asks people not to touch, feed or call to a working guide dog, because it needs to keep its mind on its job. After years of service, a guide dog retires and is adopted by a family. Aggie, for example, retired in 2003 and lived to the age of 16.

translation_zh.text:
如果你在火車站看到一隻戴著導盲鞍、冷靜行走的狗，牠可能是正在工作的導盲犬。台灣大約有 6 萬名視障者，但正在工作的導盲犬只有 50 隻左右。每一隻都花了好幾年的時間準備這份工作。
導盲犬的一生從一個志工家庭開始。幼犬大約 2 個月大時，會搬進寄養家庭。大約一年的時間裡，寄養家庭幫助牠習慣和人一起生活，在家裡學會好習慣，而訓練學校則支付牠的食物和醫療費用。有些幼犬甚至會到坐滿加油棒球迷的球場，練習保持冷靜。
狗大約一歲半時，會回到學校再接受大約一年的訓練。在那裡，牠學會在階梯前停下、繞過擋路的東西，並安全地帶領使用者。養成一隻導盲犬總共大約要三年，但最後只有大約三成的狗能通過。
台灣第一隻導盲犬是一隻名叫雅琪的拉布拉多，1996 年開始工作。一開始，有些公車拒絕載她，有些餐廳不讓她進去。她的使用者努力改變規定。現在法律規定，導盲犬以及由訓練人員帶著的幼犬，可以進入公共場所、餐廳和大眾運輸工具。業者不能拒絕或額外收費，一再拒絕的地方最高可罰新台幣 5 萬元。即使如此，2023 到 2025 年間仍有 47 件導盲犬被拒絕進入的通報。
法律也要求大家不要觸摸、餵食或呼叫工作中的導盲犬，因為牠需要專心工作。服務多年之後，導盲犬會退休，由家庭領養。例如雅琪在 2003 年退休，活到 16 歲。
